name: 16267-longdecode-mimov2flash-tp8
model: XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-V2-Flash. Not substitutable. 313.1 GB of safetensors, ungated, and NOT in the local HF cache.
hardware: 8x H100 80GB HBM3, one node. No router, no external cache tier.
parallelism: TP=8 with DP-attention 2: attention at TP=4 in each of two groups, MoE over all 8 ranks; PP=1, EP=1. Eight-way is what 313 GB of weights requires.
architecture: MiMoV2FlashForCausalLM, 309.8B parameters over 48 layers, 256 routed experts with top-8 routing, block-wise FP8 E4M3; the rest is in the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=64, warmup the first 25%, bounded at 512 requests with a 2400 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix structure: prompts ~4096 tokens (stdev 256, clipped to [3584, 4608]), outputs ~1024 tokens (stdev 64, clipped to [896, 1152]), `temperature: 0.0` and `ignore_eos: true`, seed 42.
purpose: A report-drafting assistant on a 310-billion-parameter model, serving 64 concurrent streams with long prompts and thousand-token answers on eight GPUs.
launch:
# sglang at commit dd93e4451cc22c99a19f9d56968b2f7a7b467d33, eight GPUs of one node serving
# MiMo-V2-Flash at FP8. Nothing here is tuned.

model-path: XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-V2-Flash
tp-size: 8

# Two DP-attention groups: attention runs at TP 4 inside each, the MoE keeps all eight ranks.
# This checkpoint's FP8 attention block scales load at attention TP 4 (its own SGLang layout), not at 8.
dp-size: 2
enable-dp-attention: true

# The checkpoint ships an auto_map and its own tokenizer files; it will not load without this.
trust-remote-code: true

# Named explicitly: this architecture is not on the engine's fa3-by-default list at this commit,
# so omitting the key would select a backend on availability grounds instead.
attention-backend: fa3

context-length: 32768
chunked-prefill-size: 4096
max-prefill-tokens: 4096
disable-radix-cache: true
mem-fraction-static: 0.85
